title: I’ve been working on a project: a living bonsai tree that you keep on your desktop while it grows in real time
author: 2nd_breakfastt
selftext:
I’ve been working on a project called Bonsai Studio!

Lets you grow and customize a Bonzai tree that you can place anywhere on your desktop while you’re gaming/working/chilling

Watch your tree grow in real time (accelerated) and watch how it changes with how you take care of it

comments.author: Objify
comments.body: lovely. how can I access it

replies.author: 2nd_breakfastt
replies.body: Thanks feel free to check it out here https://ynotved.itch.io/bonsai-studio

comments.author: procrastinator6900
comments.body: Really nice idea and execution. It’s great seeing something original here. Nice work!

comments.author: BudgeSoftGames
comments.body:
Bonsai don't grow much... isn't that what they do?  

Maybe next version have choices for different plants that are more work.. weeds, grass.. or weed and grass.  Pot farmer!

replies.author: 2nd_breakfastt
replies.body:
Haha agreed! Yeah bonsai trees don’t grow very quickly, but they do grow, which is why there’s accelerated time and a creative mode to really explore the customization 

If you choose not to upkeep your tree you see the difference over time. With all the tools available, you’re able to see the satisfying growth while you use your computer, with the option to place it wherever you want 

Plan is to add more trees/plants, add more into the background options, etc

Let me know if there’s anything you’d like to see in the game!

replies.author: 2nd_breakfastt
replies.body:
Don’t worry next update (tonight) it’ll be available on Mac and Linux 

I’ll also upload a playable version on the browser. The browser version just won’t have access to the desktop tree, but will have access to the full studio

replies.author: 2nd_breakfastt
replies.body: Demo’s now available on Mac, Linux and web browser!

comments.author: beimgoods_official
comments.body: very cool digital Bonsai. (i recently learned you can bonsai almost anything...such a neat idea)

replies.author: 2nd_breakfastt
replies.body: Appreciate it! Yes the plan is to add more trees/plants to be able to customize in the near future

replies.author: 2nd_breakfastt
replies.body: Thank you. Let me know your feedback if you end up trying it out

replies.author: 2nd_breakfastt
replies.body: and feed it nutrients if you want it to grow at its full potential!

replies.author: Fun-Meaning-6474
replies.body: is there any miner behind the bonsai?)

replies.author: SeasawPhilosopher
replies.body: Any plans to add rocks, moss, stone pagodas, and other stuff you can add to the pot? Would be really cool to have a rocky scene in the pot with the bonsai growing from twisted roots over the rocks.

replies.author: 2nd_breakfastt
replies.body: I love the vision! That would be neat, adding that to my ideas list. Moss, stones and little ornaments like a stone lantern or pagoda are on my list too. I'd like them to be more than decoration where I can, like the rock you plant on shaping how the tree grows or something similar. Thanks for the great suggestion

comments.author: crackedpotstudio
comments.body: Hahaha this is so cool! Looks a bit like what I’m currently doing in my bonsai farming game, you can style them more or less the same way as showcased [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0hk77mGISnE) , cool project!
